hgb_self_healing_compile.description: Autonomous First-Green compilation loop: executes build/checks in RAM CoW overlay sandbox, intercepts diagnostics, and heals AST syntax errors before disk commit

target_file.description: Relative path to target source file

code.description: Candidate source code string to verify and heal

command.description: Compiler check command (e.g. cargo check, zig test, python3 -m py_compile)

ollama_speculative_generate.description: Speculative Decoding LLM inference using fast draft model (qwen2.5-coder:1.5b) validated by sovereign target model (phi3:3.8b) with zero-failure fallback

prompt.description: Prompt or instruction for speculative synthesis

ollama_task_split.description: Autonomous task complexity evaluator routing prompts between sub-second draft models (1.5B) and deep reasoning models (3.8B/7B)

prompt.description: Prompt or code task to evaluate

hgb_mcp_run_tests.description: Execute cargo test asynchronously with real-time diagnostic parsing (extracting compilation errors E0308, E0425, test assertion panics, and stack traces)

test_name.description: Specific test function or filter name

hgb_mcp_read_patch.description: Read patch file from .hgb/patches/ or filesystem path, returning metadata, target files, line additions/deletions, and raw unified diff

patch_name_or_path.description: Patch filename in .hgb/patches/ or relative/absolute path

hgb_mcp_apply_patch.description: Atomically validate and apply unified diff. If dry_run is true, tests inside RAM CoW OverlaySandbox in /dev/shm. If real, atomically applies to workspace files, verifies syntax, and records timeline checkpoint in .hgb/timelines/

patch_content.description: Raw unified diff patch content to apply

dry_run.description: Dry run verification inside RAM CoW sandbox without modifying disk

hgb_mcp_sandbox_exec.description: Execute untrusted code (Rust, Zig, Bash, Python) inside isolated ephemeral sandbox (Landlock LSM /dev/shm CoW or Firecracker microVM), measuring duration, memory, and blast radius

code.description: Source code or script payload to execute

use_microvm.description: Attempt hardware-isolated Firecracker microVM (/dev/kvm) if available

hgb_daemon_telemetry.description: Return live Hagibis daemon health, uptime, active models, dynatune thermal/power state, vector mesh status, and memory stats

hgb_filesystem_tree.description: Generate compact ASCII and JSON directory tree of workspace files with sizes, line counts, and git modified status

path.description: Relative directory path to inspect (defaults to workspace root)

include_git_status.description: Include git modified/staged status for each file

hgb_code_skeleton.description: Extract AST signatures of large files using syn-based CodeSkeletonizer (reducing prompt context token consumption by >70% while preserving structs, traits, and method interfaces)

content.description: Optional inline source code content (reads file_path if omitted)

file_ext.description: Optional file extension override (rs, py, ts, zig, go)

hgb_time_machine_rollback.description: Atomically roll back the entire workspace to a specific cryptographic checkpoint snapshot or latest checkpoint with zero data loss

checkpoint_id.description: Target checkpoint snapshot ID (defaults to most recent checkpoint)

hgb_undo.description: Instant atomic 1-key undo: reverts workspace changes back to the immediately preceding checkpoint

hgb_vault_get_secret.description: Access AEAD-encrypted API keys and ghost envs safely without putting credentials into plaintext prompts

key.description: Environment variable or secret credential name (e.g. STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY)

hgb_vault_set_secret.description: Store API key or credential securely inside AEAD-encrypted ghost vault (.hgb/.env.vault) with fresh 96-bit nonce and HMAC-SHA256 authentication tag

key.description: Environment variable or secret credential name

value.description: Plaintext secret value to seal into encrypted vault

hgb_cdp_tweak_sync.description: Live DevTools Click-to-Source sync: bridges browser DOM element tweaks directly back into source JSX, TSX, Vue, or HTML files with surgical line replacements

apply_to_disk.description: Commit verified tweak directly to disk

hgb_mirage_mock.description: Spin up synthetic mock backends or execute simulated calls for Stripe, GitHub, Resend, and Auth0 using ApiMirageEngine

port.description: Port to bind when starting mock server

hgb_baas_graduate.description: Auto-generate Supabase/Neon PostgreSQL DDL + RLS security policies + TypeScript SDK from in-memory prototypes using BaasGraduateEngine

sample_json.description: Sample JSON record or schema structure

hgb_mobile_teleport.description: Generate instant terminal ANSI QR code and PWA manifest scaffolding for mobile device live preview teleportation

target_url.description: Target HTTP/HTTPS URL to teleport (dev server or tunnel)

hgb_figma_sync.description: Bi-directional Figma design token extraction and React/Tailwind component synchronization

file_key.description: Figma file key or URL identifier

figma_json.description: Optional inline Figma REST JSON payload

hgb_git_micro_commit.description: Atomically stage verified files and create conventional micro-commits with rollback safety

intent.description: Semantic commit intent or bugfix description

path.description: Optional single file path or target directory to stage

hgb_agentic_bisect.description: Autonomous binary search across Git revisions to isolate regression culprits and generate root-cause analysis

good_commit.description: Known good commit hash or revision

bad_commit.description: Known bad commit hash or revision

test_cmd.description: Automated verification test command (e.g. 'cargo test', 'npm test')

hgb_nightshift.description: Dispatch autonomous 4-stage night-shift swarm pipeline in an isolated git worktree branch

goal.description: High-level goal or ticket specification for autonomous execution

hgb_desktop_drive.description: OS-level desktop window sentry and mouse/keyboard action dispatcher

action.description: Action to perform: inspect, click, type, key, focus, screenshot

x.description: Optional X coordinate for mouse actions

y.description: Optional Y coordinate for mouse actions

text.description: Optional text to type or key name to press

hgb_viral_og.description: Generate high-CTR dynamic SVG OpenGraph launch cards, Twitter/X meta tags, and Next.js edge route code

hgb_system_health.description: Real-time system telemetry: CPU temperature, CPU frequency, active governor, EPP, battery percentage, RAM free/used, and MGLRU active indicator

detailed.description: Include per-core frequency and power supply uevent metrics

hgb_cgroup_control.description: Inspect and adjust cgroup v2 resource limits (/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max, /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max, /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.current) for sandboxed tasks

action.description: Action: inspect limits or adjust limits

cgroup_path.description: Custom cgroup v2 directory path (defaults to auto-detected process cgroup)

cpu_max.description: CPU quota and period string for cpu.max (e.g. 'max 100000' or '50000 100000')

memory_max.description: Memory limit bytes or 'max' for memory.max (e.g. '536870912')

hgb_microvm_status.description: Inspect Firecracker microVM hardware virtualization support (/dev/kvm presence, Firecracker binary, active jail count, and kernel/rootfs images)

detailed.description: Include kernel/rootfs paths, jail directory listings, and active process stats

hgb_wasm_wit_exec.description: Execute sandboxed WebAssembly WIT tasks directly through Wasmtime with fuel metering, capability routing, and resilient native fallback

task.description: Sandboxed WASM WIT task capability to execute

payload.description: Task input parameters (logs text, query/target vectors, patch diff, or state envelope)

wasm_path.description: Optional custom .wasm module path (defaults to compiled sovereign microkernel)

fuel_limit.description: Instruction fuel limit for sandboxed execution (default: 10000000)
